scope: New development studies only. Completed cohorts and original matrix/F1/final-test gates are unchanged.

stages.purpose: Separate fixed epsilon escape from approximate GPI preference transfer without learning
stages.models: All 12 frozen final checkpoints, no best-seed/head selection
stages.source_weight_bank: Same protocol-seeded 32 training preferences; source w inside conditional critic, requested w scalarizes outside; head-mean approximation has no certified error bound
stages.preferences: The two original task preferences per environment
stages.gate: For task-oriented weights: every training seed must reach 8/10 native task outcomes, with paired utility improvement over its plain-mean control; pure-fuel has no task requirement. Report random/heuristic references separately and do not pool shared reference cases.

stages.purpose: If P1 is insufficient, isolate preference reuse and preference-aligned critic loss in a fixed 2x2 Minecart study
stages.loss: (1-lambda)*masked mean vector Huber + lambda*masked Huber of w-dot TD error; lambda .5 is a fixed prospective intervention, not an optimized or paper-proven default
stages.uniform_relabel: One independent pool preference per sampled transition, recompute its DDQN target; no extra gradient updates, PER or achieved-return projection

common_settings.extraction: same mean-greedy for all four arms

stages.validation: 32 parent validation preferences x3 episodes/checkpoint; task diagnostics and raw-trace retention separate
stages.gate: No adaptive-benefit claim. Require all three seeds to reach 8/10 delivery on each declared ore-seeking task preference and improve paired utility versus A; do not claim success from one seed or fuel-only utility. Prefer B or C over D if a simpler cell already meets the gate. If all fail, stop this finite study.

stages.purpose: Independent confirmation of one predeclared selected intervention and cross-environment reliability
stages.condition: Only after P1 or P2 passes; freeze exact method before execution
stages.gate: At least 8/10 delivery/landing-pad cases per training seed at declared task-oriented profiles; utility/HV and native trade-offs on new preferences; no dynamics-generalization claim. If P1 requires no training, confirmation remains frozen-model evaluation and must not consume this training allocation by default.
stages.execution_requires: A separately frozen full evaluation matrix, explicit task profiles, source and qualification receipt; this stage is a conditional design, not an executable protocol.

stages.purpose: Only after a qualified backbone, test the original adaptive-allocation benefit
stages.condition: A separately frozen new comparison; never unlock or relaunch failed matrix-v1/F1 implicitly
stages.gate: Matched interactions, updates and tuning; explicit curriculum/evaluation budgets; retain seed-level effects and failures. No superiority claim if unsupported.

decision_policy: Stages are conditional, not a queue to run in full. The smallest validated change is preferred. No parameter sweep, outcome-based extension, seed substitution, best-checkpoint selection or paid compute. Alternative on-policy/PPO work needs a separate source-aligned plan if these stages fail.
course_scope: P1/P2 plus independent confirmation can support a scoped backbone/preference-transfer report. Claiming adaptive allocation improves performance requires P4; full original RQs remain separate.
